searchText: So some questions and avenues that need exploring for EIP-3074: - Should we add an address field to `AUTH`? Would use a bit more memory, but would be way more compatible with a Smart Contract Wallet future. - Does 3074 make sense at all in a smart contract wallet world? - `AUTHUSURP` (https://twitter.com/_SamWilsn_/status/1482057405219364868)
